text:
tara: seeing recurring GPU stalls in eu-central-1a since ~03:00 UTC. affected a few dedicated slices. telemetry -> NIC egress saturation + kernel tx_drops spike. wondering if noisy neighbor is actually network-driven this time.
ben: can you paste the tail of the node logs?
tara: here are the tails from node-42 / gpu-alloc-7:
```
Mar 20 03:02:11 node-42 kernel: tx_dropped 4200 packets on eth0
Mar 20 03:02:12 gpu-alloc-7 stall_ms=480 p95=520
Mar 20 03:02:13 node-42 netstat -i: txqueuelen=1000 errors=0 dropped=4200
```
olivia: confirmed on my side. kv-cache spillovers + concurrent host-level backups created long DMA bursts to egress. looks like batchers on dedicated slices are cold-caching large model shards and hammering the network.
reza: odd that dedicated slices are hit harder — think reserved pools didn't get the latest egress-shaping patch? possible missing tc qdisc per-reservation.
infra-bot: incident INC-2026-0345 created (eu-central egress surge affecting gpu stalls)
sam: quick cost note: if we enforce strict per-slice policing we'll see ~8% throughput loss on heavy tenants but expect ~90% reduction in stalls. back-of-envelope monthly delta ~ $4k/region if we need more headroom.
tara: proposal (short-term): 1) enable per-slice tc policing on eu-central canary nodes (cap at 20Gbps) 2) schedule the largest-egress tenants onto isolated reserve nodes 3) enable kernel irq-affinity tweak for NIC/GPU threads to reduce RX jitter.
ben: low-risk rollout plan: canary on 3 nodes tonight, monitor p95/tx_drops for 2h, then 10 nodes. I'll push the canary config and watch.
olivia: i'll own dashboards & alerts — will add a new alert: stall_p95 > 200ms for 2m -> notify #incidents & paging. also add a small eval to auto-shrink batching if stall_detected.
reza: long-term action: consider dedicated egress NIC pools for reserved workloads + topology-aware placement so we avoid co-hosting bursty egress with steady-core tenants. this should reduce cross-tenant interference without huge perf loss.
tara: @sam please attach the cost spreadsheet to INC-2026-0345 and link the runbook: <https://redwood-internal/ops/egress-shielding>
infra-bot: INC-2026-0345 updated: priority=P2, assignees=[tara, ben, olivia, reza], status=investigating
ben: starting canary in 5m. will post results here. :thumbsup:
